editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: tursodatabase/turso
items.summary: Turso offers an in-process SQL database that is compatible with SQLite. This system, developed in Rust language, simplifies data management processes by integrating into application processes.

items.title: jamiepine/voicebox
items.summary: Voicebox is an open source artificial intelligence voice studio that allows users to perform voice cloning, dictation and content creation. Developed with the TypeScript language, this platform offers comprehensive tools to manage audio processing processes in the native environment.

items.title: pppscn/SmsForwarder
items.summary: SmsForwarder is a tool that forwards text messages, calls and application notifications on Android devices to different messaging platforms or webhooks within the framework of specified rules. This software, which allows users to remotely manage their devices and access data such as battery status and contacts, was developed with the Kotlin language.

items.title: 1jehuang/jcode
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, jcode offers a framework for testing and evaluating coding-oriented artificial intelligence agents. It provides a standard infrastructure to measure the performance of agents used in software development processes.

items.title: SMPTE Makes Its Standards Freely Accessible
items.summary: The Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers (SMPTE) has made its media technology standards freely available to the global community. This step aims to ensure wider adoption of the digital media standards library across the industry.

items.title: Loupe – A iOS app that raises awareness about what native apps can see
items.summary: Loupe is an iOS application that aims to increase user awareness by visualizing what data native apps can access on the device. The software transparently reports the data access processes carried out by applications in the background.

items.title: DOS Game "F-15 Strike Eagle II" reversing project needs DOS test pilots
items.summary: The reverse engineering project of the F-15 Strike Eagle II game is looking for test pilots to verify the software's operability in different DOS environments. The work aims to preserve the classic game's source code by adapting it to modern systems.

items.title: Renting a sewing machine from the library
items.summary: Libraries in Finland are transforming the traditional book-focused service model by lending out a wide range of items, from sewing machines to drill sets. This application combines the sharing economy model, which aims to reduce consumption habits, with library infrastructure.

items.title: Temporary Cloudflare accounts for AI agents
items.summary: Cloudflare offers an infrastructure that allows the creation of temporary cloud accounts so that artificial intelligence agents can work safely. This system simplifies the authorization processes of agents and enables them to work with limited access permissions for a limited time.
